'''Edward Brian Davies''' {{post-nominals|country=GBR|FRS}} (13 June 1944 – 2 June 2025) was a British mathematician who was professor of Mathematics, [[King's College London]] (1981–2010), and was the author of the [[popular science]] book ''Science in the Looking Glass: What do Scientists Really Know''.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Davies |first=IoaN |date=1987 |title=Professor John G. Phillips, FRS |url=https://doi.org/10.1093/ageing/16.5.337 |journal=Age and Ageing |volume=16 |issue=5 |pages=337–337 |doi=10.1093/ageing/16.5.337 |issn=0002-0729|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>[http://www.ukwhoswho.com/view/article/oupww/whoswho/U13001 Davies, Prof. (Edward) Brian], ''Who's Who 2015'', A & C Black, 2015; online edn, Oxford University Press, 2014</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Davies, Prof. (Edward) Brian |url=https://www.ukwhoswho.com/display/10.1093/ww/9780199540891.001.0001/ww-9780199540884-e-13001?rskey=NgknM8&result=64 |website=WHO WAS WHO 2026 |access-date=3 January 2026}}</ref> In 2010, he was awarded a [[Gauss Lectureship|Gauss Lecture]] by the [[German Mathematical Society]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mathematik.de/chronik-der-gau%C3%9F-vorlesungen|title=Chronik der Gauß-Vorlesungen|language=de|publisher=German Mathematical Society|access-date=2024-04-19}}</ref>

Davies died on 2 June 2025, at the age of 80.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Schlitzer |first1=Enrico |title=Edward Brian Davies (1944–2025) |url=https://euromathsoc.org/news/edward-brian-davies-(1944-2025)-178 |access-date=3 January 2026 |publisher=European Mathematical Society |date=23 June 2025}}</ref>
